# IAltTextProvider

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Optional companion to `IRoleProvider` for elements that can supply alt-text. When tagging is enabled and the element implements this interface, the pipeline writes `AltText` onto the open structure element's `/Alt` entry.

Used by `Image`, `QRCode`, and other media elements where PDF/UA requires an alternate text description for assistive tech.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Properties

- [`AltText`](#alttext): The alternate text for this element.
- [`IsDecorative`](#isdecorative): When `true`, the author has explicitly opted into a decorative-only rendering: the element is tagged as `/Artifact` with no warning, even though no alt-text is provided.

### `AltText`

```csharp
string AltText { get; }
```

*read-only*

The alternate text for this element. `null` or empty means "no alt-text"; the renderer treats such elements as `/Artifact` rather than `/Figure` when tagging is on, and logs a build-time warning so authors don't silently produce inaccessible figures.

### `IsDecorative`

```csharp
bool IsDecorative { get; }
```

*read-only*

When `true`, the author has explicitly opted into a decorative-only rendering: the element is tagged as `/Artifact` with no warning, even though no alt-text is provided. Distinguishes "missing alt by mistake" from "no alt is correct".
